messages:
maria: Weekend poll — low effort plans: 1) boardwalk sunset bike + tacos, 2) ridge hike + viewpoint, 3) indoor potluck (rain option). Who's in? :sun_with_face: :bike:
ajay: Boardwalk sounds perfect. I can bring a portable speaker and some hot sauce :fire:
sam: I vote hike but can only do early morning (7am). Is the ridge trail muddy?
liz: Potluck if it rains, otherwise boardwalk. I can bring my famous kimchi pancakes (veg). :yum:
ben: Count me in for tacos at the boardwalk! What time you thinking? 6pm?
tasha: @sam the trail has a steep section but drains well. Last weekend looked ok — link: https://maps.example/trails/ridgeview
ops-bot: Reminder: team picnic rules — no glass, pack out trash.
maria: Nice. Let's do boardwalk at 6pm Sat by the west entrance (near Pier 4). If weather looks bad by Fri 3pm we'll switch to potluck at my place. RSVP here: react with :thumbsup: if you're coming to boardwalk, :house: for potluck, :hiking_boot: for hike.
ajay: :thumbsup:
sam: :hiking_boot: (only early, otherwise won't make the 6pm)
liz: :thumbsup: (if rain icon shows up i'll text you for potluck supplies)
ben: :thumbsup: bring napkins pls lol
tasha: :thumbsup: i'll bring compostable plates
maria: Great! If anyone needs a bike lock i have extras. See you Saturday — bringing a small cooler and some spicy salsa. :taco::bike::sunset:
